# clavis schema infer

<p class="cli-lead">Suggest a schema from the current environment</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis schema infer [flags]
```

</div>

Suggest a schema from the current environment. The output has types and kinds, never values. Review it before you push.

## Examples

```sh
clavis schema infer
clavis schema infer -o clavis.schema.yaml
clavis schema infer --push
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-out"><dt><code>-o, --out string</code></dt><dd>output file (default stdout)</dd></div>
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-push"><dt><code>--push</code></dt><dd>upload the inferred schema instead of printing it</dd></div>
</dl>
